::: {.obsidian-board-pack}
:::

State the purpose of the pack in one paragraph. Summarise the
decisions the board must take at this meeting.

# Chairman's report

Summarise the position since the last meeting. Name the major
events and the decisions taken by the executive.

# Financial report

Present the financial position. Give the revenue, the costs, the
cash position, and the variance against budget.

# Operational report

Present the operational position. Name the key metrics, the
deliverables, and the risks.

# Papers for decision

List each paper for decision. For each, state the recommendation
and the decision required.

# Papers for noting

List each paper for noting. These need no decision.
